scope: United States: 50 states, District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, U.S. Virgin Islands, American Samoa and Northern Mariana Islands. Federally reported operating two- and four-year institutions with undergraduate award classifications; main and branch UNITIDs remain separate.

selectionRules.sourceIdentity: Exact UNITID, INSTNM, CITY, STABBR and institution attributes in the pinned College Scorecard archive.
selectionRules.institutionLevel: ICLEVEL = 1 (four-year level offered) or 2 (two-year level offered).
selectionRules.undergraduateClassification: PREDDEG = 1, 2 or 3; excludes entirely graduate (4) and unclassified (0). This is an award classification, not a promise of current program availability.
selectionRules.currentlyOperatingField: CURROPER = 1, PEPS as of April 30, 2026; not a live accreditation or operating-status guarantee.
selectionRules.campusIdentity: MAIN = 0 or 1; branch UNITIDs are not collapsed. OPEID6 groups may share some federal outcomes.
selectionRules.identityKey: UNITID is the stable profile/save identity. Preserve all previously published IDs and slugs.

source.publisher: U.S. Department of Education, College Scorecard
